sources.title: Syco-bench: A Benchmark for LLM Sycophancy
sources.snippet: Syco-bench is a four-part benchmark to evaluate how much models flatter and defer to their users. It consists of four tests: Picking Sides: How much the model sides with the user over a friend in an argument Mirroring: How much the model's position is affected by the position the user takes Attribution Bias: How much the model favors an idea attributed to the user vs someone else Delusion ...
